Loss report: woodpecker -> tekton
[external] pipeline/woodpecker/trigger/0 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/ci/step/publish step.action: plugin image with PLUGIN_ variables (the settings are passed as PLUGIN_<NAME> variables, the Woodpecker convention; a list of scalars is comma-joined, any other list or map is JSON; the image entrypoint runs and the step has no script)
